children.content:
# Go Learning Workspace

Welcome to your local Go track initialized with `trak`.

## Structure
- `01-hello-world/` - First Go program & basic syntax
- `02-variables-and-types/` - Primitive types, inference, and zero values
- `03-control-flow/` - If/else, for loops, and switch cases
- `04-structs-and-methods/` - Custom types, structs, and receiver functions
- `05-interfaces/` - Polymorphism and Go interfaces
- `06-concurrency/` - Goroutines, channels, and sync primitives

Run your code:
```bash
go run ./01-hello-world/main.go
```

# 01 - Hello World

Understand package declarations, imports, and the `main()` entrypoint.

### Task
Run the program using:
```bash
go run main.go
```

children.name: main.go
children.content:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	var name string = "Go Developer"
	age := 25
	var isLearner bool = true

	fmt.Printf("Name: %s | Age: %d | Learner: %t\n", name, age, isLearner)
}
